planner.access_tokyo_rental: From Tokyo, take the Shinkansen to Morioka or Hachinohe, then use a rental car around Hirono Town.
planner.access_tokyo_car: From Tokyo, this is a long drive via the Tohoku Expressway. Plan rest stops along the way.
planner.access_tokyo_public: From Tokyo, use the Shinkansen and local trains. Getting around town may rely on walking, taxis, or local buses.
planner.access_morioka_rental: From Morioka, about one hour by car or rental car—good for visiting key spots efficiently.
planner.access_morioka_car: Morioka is an easy drive by own car, ideal for day trips or one-night stays.
planner.access_morioka_public: Public transport from Morioka works, but some spots take longer to reach.
planner.access_hachinohe_rental: From Hachinohe, a rental car helps you explore Hirono and the coast.
planner.access_hachinohe_car: Hachinohe is a relatively smooth drive to Hirono by own car.
planner.access_hachinohe_public: Public transport from Hachinohe is possible. Check bus timetables in advance.
planner.access_hanamaki_rental: From Hanamaki / Kitakami, a rental car is a practical way to reach Hirono.
planner.access_hanamaki_car: From Hanamaki / Kitakami, own car is the most realistic option.
planner.access_nearby_car: You're visiting from near Hirono Town—short hops between multiple spots.
planner.access_nearby_public: A model for visitors using public transport from nearby areas.
planner.access_public_notice: Spots that are difficult by public transport alone are excluded from this itinerary.
planner.season_spring: Spring is great for coastal walks and outdoor spots.
planner.season_summer: Summer brings seaside fun and events. Sun protection and hydration recommended.
planner.season_autumn: Autumn offers comfortable weather for walks and drives.
planner.season_winter: Winter requires warm clothing. Night spots like the observatory need extra layers.

location.title: Where is Hirono Town?
location.lead: At the northern tip of Iwate Prefecture, on the Pacific coast bordering Aomori. About 1.5 hours by car from Morioka, or 1 hour from Hachinohe.
location.caption: Hirono Town, Kuji area, Iwate Prefecture
location.alt: Map of northern Tohoku showing Hirono Town in the Kuji area of Iwate Prefecture.

cards.title: Starry skies
cards.body: See stars you can't find in the city at Hirono Makiba Observatory.

cards.title: Beautiful coast
cards.body: Take in Taneichi Coast and unwind to the sound of the waves.

cards.title: Fresh seafood
cards.body: Savor local flavors at Hamanasu-tei and other favorites.

cards.title: Hot springs & spa
cards.body: Relax at Marine Side Spa Taneichi or Green Hill Ohno.

cards.title: Roadside station

items.question: Is it free?
items.answer: Yes — the quiz is completely free to use.

items.question: Do I need to sign up?
items.answer: No registration required. You can start right away.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: 5 questions, about 30 seconds. Try it easily on your phone.

items.question: Can families use it?
items.answer: Yes. Many families take the quiz together and compare their travel types.
